events.title: Delaware hit by rare November tornado
events.description: Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms bring hailstones the size of baseballs in Argentina The National Weather Service in the US has confirmed that an EF1 tornado touched down south-east of Newark in the Salem Woods neighbourhood, Delaware, on Thursday. The tornado reached 160 metres wide, had a path length of 4.4 miles (7.1km) and reached estimated peak winds of up to 100mph (161km/h). There were no injuries or fatalities but windows and roofs were damaged on several homes, a large hotel sign fell on to a number of cars, and a semi truck overturned on I95. Although Delaware often experiences a few tornadoes every year, this is only the second time the state has had tornado activity in November since 1950, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. The only other November tornado recorded was in 1989. Severe storms have also resulted in tornadoes in Argentina as well as large hailstones. A round of severe thunderstorms moved through the central Córdoba province on Friday, bringing hailstones up to the size of a baseball (about 7.5cm in diameter). Parts of the province recorded up to 73mm of rainfall in just six hours early on Saturday. Such storms are common at this time of year. Water vapour from the Amazon meeting the Andes quickly condenses, resulting in massive cloud formations often associated with heavy downpours, lightning, tornadoes and large hailstones. Continue reading...
events.ticker_label: 🌪️ Delaware hit by rare November tornado

events.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
events.description: Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations. After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas. events.title: 5 European countries aim to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda
events.description: A group of European countries announced Monday that they aim to set up a “return hub” in Rwanda where rejected asylum seekers could be sent from next year, a move that they hope will also deter more people from coming. The plan by Austria, Denmark, Germany, Greece and the Netherlands, which have spearheaded negotiations with non-EU countries, drew immediate criticism from human rights groups.

events.title: Three Melbourne Cup trophies worth £500k each stolen
events.description: Police are searching for three Melbourne Cup trophies collectively worth more than £1.5m after they were stolen from a display cabinet at a racecourse in Melbourne.

events.title: US to further curb China's access to Nvidia chips
events.description: The US government is set to further restrict China's access to the most powerful AI chips, such as the ones provided by tech giant Nvidia.

events.title: Retrial date set for Lindsay Clancy over killing of her three children
events.description: Lindsay Clancy is due to face a retrial next March over the killing of her three young children.

events.title: David Beckham sues after his fragrance is sold in gas stations and discount stores
events.description: David Beckham’s company is suing beauty group Coty for at least $41 million, alleging that sales of his perfumes in discount stores breached their licensing agreement and damaged his luxury brand

events.title: How Europe decided on 'return hubs' for migrants
events.description: A group of European countries has announced plans to establish a "migrant hub" in Rwanda for rejected asylum-seekers

events.title: Another commercial vessel sinks off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
events.description: The Bulgarian Defense Ministry says that a Liberia-flagged gas tanker sank in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea

events.title: EU-backed court convicts Kosovo ex-President of attempting to obstruct justice
events.description: A European Union-backed court has convicted Kosovo's former president, Hashim Thaci, of trying to obstruct justice and contempt of court

events.title: More than 200 people jailed over crackdown on illegal gold mining
events.description: A court in Guinea has sentenced 22 former officials and 202 miners to prison over illegal gold mining in the northeast

events.title: Pope forgives person who nailed him in the eye with a rosary in Peru
events.description: Pope Leo XIV has forgiven the person who threw a rosary at him before his final Mass in Peru and nailed him in the eye

events.title: Pope Leo says there is no change to agenda or priorities after his lung cancer surgery
events.description: Pope Leo XIV says his recent lung cancer surgery hasn't changed his agenda or outlook

events.title: Malaysia-France rare earths project to begin operations in early 2027, Macron says
events.description: A joint rare earths mining and processing venture between Malaysia and France is expected to begin operations in early 2027

events.title: Mongolia’s president says he will step down after facing accusations of corruption
events.description: Mongolia’s President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa says he will resign after a member of a faction of his own party accused him of benefiting financially from a government railway project

events.title: Mexican drug kingpin Félix Gallardo, founder of Guadalajara cartel, dies at 80
events.description: Gallardo, nicknamed the “Boss of Bosses,” died of multiple organ failure.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Mexican drug kingpin Félix Gallardo, founder of Guadalajara cartel, dies at 80

events.title: Funding cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation for refugee children
events.description: Sharp reductions in humanitarian funding are putting refugees, particularly children, at increased risk of being trafficked, exploited or abused, while the systems that protect them are weakening.

events.title: Guterres calls for a legally binding instrument for ‘killer robots'
events.description: Talks began in Geneva on Monday to push for controls on lethal autonomous weapons systems that are often referred to as “killer robots”.

events.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
events.description: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.

events.title: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years
events.description: In a quiet hospital corridor in Kyiv, staff and volunteers push carts carrying steaming pots of chicken soup, bread and buckwheat porridge to patients recently evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region.
events.ticker_label: 💥 ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years

events.title: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
events.description: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.

events.title: Ivy League student slashed in neck, suspect accused was arrested just weeks before
events.description: NYPD says a Barnard College student was slashed behind her ear outside a Columbia University dorm as Earl Baker, a 44-year-old Brooklyn man, was arrested.

events.title: President Trump opens Asia trip with dealmaking on tap and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: America hits a tech wall as outages cripple email, ground flights and disrupt major banks
events.description: A wave of tech failures hit Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo online banking Monday, days after a Microsoft 365 outage and FAA ground stop.

events.title: Trump border crackdown drives encounters to record October low as zero-release streak hits 18 months, DHS says
events.description: Border Patrol recorded just 8,288 southwest border apprehensions in October, marking a stunning 95% drop from the Biden administration's average.

events.title: After UN peacekeeping mission ends, Morocco says Western Sahara dispute enters new phase
events.description: Western Sahara talks enter a new phase as a senior Sahrawi official says Morocco will implement its autonomy proposal even if the Polisario Front refuses to agree.

events.title: American basketball player’s Nigeria trip ends in arrest after officials spot him abandoning suspicious bags
events.description: Nigerian officials say an American basketball player abandoned two checked bags containing 75 pounds of cannabis before officers arrested him in a parking lot.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV hit in the face by flying rosary during farewell Mass in Peru, video shows
events.description: Pope Leo XIV was struck near the eye by a rosary tossed at his popemobile in Lima, Peru, video shows, but the pontiff continued the farewell Mass.

events.title: Mexico's cartel 'godfather' convicted in American DEA agent's murder dies at age 80
events.description: The Guadalajara cartel boss convicted in DEA agent Enrique "Kiki" Camarena's murder died at 80, decades after the killing triggered Operation Leyenda.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Mexico's cartel 'godfather' convicted in American DEA agent's murder dies at age 80
